title: Posted fee rebates and changing final billing bases
topic: billing fee investigation one shot capacity final tier rebate deadline
content: A pending billing-volume record is provisional. A finalized transaction refund can lower eligible volume and change the retrospective rate tier; published b_billing_volume events update the actual original bill. A correction uses the currently posted formula and is irreversible once accepted. Existing posted rebates occupy the same line’s recovery entitlement after actual reference tracing and allocation. A legal partial claim can permanently leave an unclaimed amount; a claim supported only by the provisional higher tier can exceed the final correct refund. Investigation capacity does not determine the correct monetary claim.

provenance.scope: Finite review file capacity and deadlines; not a statutory appeal limit.
